study.name: H11: 384px Flash HIGH — Text N=5
study.description:
5 text-track proposer passes with HIGH thinking at T=0.7 on the full
384px evaluation area (611 tiles). Post-hoc consensus sweep at all
thresholds (1-of-5 through 5-of-5), each fed through PV pipeline.
Comparison with Flash MINIMAL (existing) and Pro HIGH (new).
